post.caption:
Dogs have around 300 million olfactory receptors to our 6 million, a much larger brain region for processing, a separate organ for pheromones, and they smell with each nostril separately to get direction. The strangest part: a scent trail is a timeline. Older molecules have faded, so a dog can read which way you walked.
